paragraphs: Mar, son of Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi.
This is how he is cited in Yuchasin, referring to Ketubot 69a; in our Gemaras it reads only “the son of Rav Sama bar R' Ashi.”[^1]

notes.text: Yuchasin remains the supplied work title without a newly identified author/edition. Hyman contrasts initial Mar in that form with its absence from his Gemara wording; only belongs outside the quote. Heading Mar/Rav Sama/Rav Ashi and repeated full Rav Sama are preserved. The final בר״א contextually suggests bar Ashi, but a distinct abbreviated occurrence does not inherit full Rav from its heading, so its title remains R'. סט. supplies a period: 69a is a convention-based reading, with punctuation ambiguity and no modern side verification; the older note’s claim of no printed period does not match the frozen source. Machine ובגמרות/כתובית differ from supplied דבגמרות/כתובות, without source repair.
